verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents API-driven verification that returns a CLEAN or FRAUD verdict with evidence attached, plus risk scoring that drives auto-decisioning, so an automated flow has outcomes to branch on. The evidence comes only from marketing-level claims, and no response schema or failure-reason codes are shown; the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. missing for 10: documented machine-readable response schema, enumerated failure/rejection reason codes, published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, verification outcomes come back structured enough for an agent to decide on — machine-readable check results, risk signals, and failure reasons an automated onboarding flow can branch on
